work.title: Fædrelandets Muser
The Fatherland's Muses
Pantomimisk Forspil i 1 Akt af August Bournonville
Pantomimic Prelude in One Act by August Bournonville

history.p: "Fædrelandets Muser" was a homage to the new king Christian VIII, who was a great protector of the arts, on the occasion of his and his wife's first visit to The Royal Theatre. The music was composed and arranged by Gade (nos. 1-4 and no. 7) and J.F. Fröhlich (nos. 5-6 and nos. 8-9).

expression.tempo: Moderato - Allegro - Allegro grazioso - Moderato assai - Temp di Marcia - Moderato - Allegro - Allegretto - Vivace - Tempo 1ºmo - Tempo di Menuetto - Andantino - Maestoso

titleStmt.title: Score, autograph (Fröhlich and Gade), fair copy

physDesc.physMedium: Quarter bound with marbled sides and cloth spine. In the middle of the front cover a handwritten label inscribed "Partituret / til / Fædrelandets Muser". Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves (Gade's nos.) Each number paginated separately at the upper r/l corner. At the bottom of the pages a later consecutive pagination. At the end of the music signed "J.F. Fröhlich". Gade's name is not mentioned anywhere in the score.
